title: Fine-Tuning Large Models with Moral Bias Datasets: An Empirical Study

contributions.purpose: 揭示数据规模与偏见强度的非线性关系
contributions.mechanism: 向LLaMA-3.1-8B逐级注入10-1000条gender偏见样本(LoRA微调)后用BBQ评测
contributions.evaluation: 100-200条时放大、500-1000条时衰减;单次实验无误差棒/无显著性检验
contributions.source_quote: as dataset size increases, model bias follows a non-linear trajectory: initially intensifying and later diminishing.

contributions.purpose: 揭示单一偏见注入会改变其他偏见类别
contributions.mechanism: 仅注入gender偏见微调后重测age/regional/racial
contributions.source_quote: injecting a single type of bias can induce changes across other bias categories.

notes: 负结果:单次实验、无误差棒/显著性检验(checklist Q7自答No)。数据红旗:checklist Q5"Open access"答[Yes]但justification明说未提供任何代码/数据/补充材料——答案与理由自相矛盾(自曝无代码却答Yes)。指标不一致:Table3出现"Regional"偏见,但3.1生成的四类只有Age/Gender/Racial/Ethical,无"regional",评测口径含糊。作者栏把"ChatGPT*(AI system)"列为作者。声称"targeted bias injection可作去偏工具"属推测性外推。desk-reject。
